name: Pareisactus
sum: A basal iguanodontian of rhabdodontid affinity from the Late Cretaceous of the Spanish Pyrenees, known from a single bone among hundreds of hadrosaurid bones.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: A single element from the Conquès Member of the Tremp Formation, Southern Pyrenees, Spain (specimen number not read).
biology: Not described in the sources consulted.
author: Párraga and Prieto-Márquez 2019
